import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/titanic.csv')

# Convert sex and embarked columns to categorical
df['sex'] = pd.Categorical(df['sex'])
df['embarked'] = pd.Categorical(df['embarked'])

# Plot a heatmap of correlations between attributes
plt.figure(figsize=(10,6))
sns.heatmap(df.corr()[['survived']], annot=True, cmap='coolwarm', square=True)
plt.title('Correlation between attributes and Survival')
plt.xlabel('Attributes')
plt.ylabel('Attributes')
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
